conversation.content: Compose a resignation letter as if you are Zuckerberg.

message.content:
Subject: Resignation

Dear Team,

After much reflection, I have decided to step down from my role at Facebook (Meta) and transition to the next chapter of my journey. This was not an easy decision, but I believe it is the right move for me personally and for the ongoing evolution of the company I helped build.

Over the years, I’ve been privileged to work alongside extraordinary people who have shown creativity, resilience, and a shared commitment to connecting the world. Together, we navigated rapid changes in technology, user needs, and global policy. I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished—building products that empower people to share, learn, and engage in meaningful ways—while also acknowledging the responsibilities that come with such influence.

I want to express my deep gratitude to the employees, partners, and communities who have inspired me daily. I’m confident in the leadership and the teams that will continue to steer the company toward its mission with integrity, transparency, and a focus on sustaining long-term value for users and stakeholders.

In the coming weeks, I will work closely with the board and executive leadership to ensure a smooth transition. I remain committed to supporting the company’s mission and core values, even as I step into new ventures.

Thank you for the opportunity to be part of this remarkable journey.

Sincerely,

Mark Zuckerberg
